message: CleanShot is a Mac-only screenshot and screen-recording app whose Cloud tier is sold with SSO, SCIM and admin controls so an IT function can manage team access centrally instead of through personal licenses. Verified product facts support this first-email scope: Introduce CleanShot Pro to an IT/ops buyer as the tier that lets them buy team seats at $10 per user/month billed annually and set up SSO, SCIM and admin controls in CleanShot Cloud to manage team access centrally, with the single next step of starting an evaluation covered by the 30-day money-back guarantee (there is no free trial; refunds are requested from support). Draft this documented use. Treat recipient circumstances as unconfirmed.
